nodes.label: antdTheme.js
nodes.description: Ant Design theme configuration with light and dark variants, Vietnamese-compatible font stack, and component-level overrides for Table, Menu, Card, Button, Statistic.

nodes.label: copy.js
nodes.description: Clipboard copy utility. Uses navigator.clipboard API with fallback to textarea-based copy for older browsers.

nodes.label: dateHelpers.js
nodes.description: Date formatting and calculation utilities using dayjs. Handles Vietnam timezone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), Excel serial date parsing, business day calculations skipping Sundays, and warranty due date logic.

nodes.label: excelHelpers.js
nodes.description: Excel file parsing and row mapping utilities using SheetJS (XLSX). parseExcelFile reads uploaded Excel files, mapExcelRows transforms raw Excel data into warranty record objects with status normalization and date parsing.

nodes.label: fieldLabels.js
nodes.description: Field label resolution utility. Maps internal field keys (e.g., khachHang, maNhanVien) to Vietnamese display labels with safe fallback to the original key.

nodes.label: formatters.js
nodes.description: Formatting utilities: formatVND uses Intl.NumberFormat for Vietnamese Dong currency display, maskName masks personal names for privacy.

nodes.label: generateChungTu.js
nodes.description: Generates sequential document/voucher codes (chung tu) in format DDMMYYYYNBHSC{N} based on today's date and existing codes.

nodes.label: historyDisplay.js
nodes.description: History display normalization. normalizeHistoryNote converts internal field keys and status codes to Vietnamese display text. mapLoaiXuLyValue maps processing type codes to display labels.

nodes.label: historyTimeline.js
nodes.description: History timeline rendering utility. Generates human-readable change descriptions for warranty history entries, mapping field changes to Vietnamese labels.

nodes.label: historyTimeline.js.bak-field-labels
nodes.description: Backup of historyTimeline.js from before i18n field label migration. Retained for reference.

nodes.label: i18nOptions.js
nodes.description: i18n helper utilities. tStatus translates status keys via i18n. makeWarrantyOptions builds localized warranty period and processing type option lists for form dropdowns.

nodes.label: urgency.js
nodes.description: Urgency classification utility. Returns urgency level (done, overdue, urgent, soon, normal) based on warranty status and due date proximity using dayjs.

nodes.label: vietnameseText.js
nodes.description: Vietnamese text normalization utility. Fixes mojibake and legacy ASCII representations of Vietnamese diacritics in history records using a comprehensive replacement table.

nodes.label: fieldLabels.smoke.test.js
nodes.description: Smoke tests for field labels and history changes formatting. Validates Vietnamese field label resolution and history change string generation.

nodes.label: generateChungTu.test.js
nodes.description: Unit tests for generateChungTuPreview. Validates correct format generation, sequential incrementing, and ignoring codes from other days.

nodes.label: i18n.test.js
nodes.description: Integration tests for i18n setup. Validates Vietnamese as default language, core namespace loading, interpolation, and i18n-backed constants/validation messages.

nodes.label: setup.js
nodes.description: Test setup file. Imports @testing-library/jest-dom for DOM matchers used across test suite.

nodes.label: StatusTag.test.jsx
nodes.description: Component tests for StatusTag. Validates correct label and color rendering for each warranty status and fallback for unknown statuses.

nodes.label: urgency.test.js
nodes.description: Unit tests for getUrgency. Covers done/overdue/urgent/soon/normal urgency levels based on warranty status and due date.

nodes.label: vietnameseUi.test.js
nodes.description: UI tests for Vietnamese text rendering. Validates theme font stack, legacy history text normalization, and shared Vietnamese normalizer for mojibake variants.

nodes.label: vite.config.js
nodes.description: Vite build configuration. Enables React plugin, sets dev server port 8888 with proxy rules forwarding /api and /uploads to localhost:3004.

nodes.label: vitest.config.js
nodes.description: Vitest test runner configuration. Uses jsdom environment, enables globals, and references tests/setup.js for test initialization.

nodes.label: web.Dockerfile
nodes.description: Multi-stage Docker build for frontend. Stage 1: Node 20 Alpine builds the Vite/React app. Stage 2: Nginx Alpine serves static files with custom nginx.conf.

edges.label: StatusTag depends on status config and theme
shares i18n translation context with historyTimeline
provides field label mapping used by historyTimeline
normalizes history text consumed by historyTimeline
shares Vietnamese normalization logic with historyDisplay
both handle date parsing (Excel serial dates vs standard dates)
runs npm build which uses vite.config.js
